ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
bookId = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
url = 'https://api-x.shrtxs.cn/qd/detail.php?bookId=' + bookId;
result = java.ajax(url)
</js>
$.Data
ruleBookInfo.name: BaseBookInfo.BookName
ruleBookInfo.author: AuthorInfo.Author
ruleBookInfo.intro: ⭐ 书籍是否限免：{{java.getString("$..IsInBlackList")==1?"非限免":"限免"}} 🆔 书号：{{$.BaseBookInfo.BookId}} 💯 等级：{{$.AuthorInfo.AuthorLevel}} 🕰 开坑：{{$.BaseBookInfo.JoinTimeCopyRight##上架}} 🏷️ 标签：{{$.BaseBookInfo.BookUgcTag..TagName||$.QQ.tag##\s|\|##，}} ✨ 角色：{{$.RoleInfo.RoleList..RoleName##\s##，}}{{'\n‎\n'}} 📜 简介：{{$.BaseBookInfo.Description}}

ruleContent.content:
<js>
bid=JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result)).bookId
cid=JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result)).chapterId
pid=JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result)).mid
vip=JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result)).vip
t=JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result)).time
token=Map('Token')
url = "https://api-x.shrtxs.cn/qd/content.php?token=" + token +"&v=" + vip + "&t=" + t + "&bookId=" + bid + "&chapterId=" + cid + (pid ? "&pid=" + pid : "");
c=JSON.parse(java.ajax(url)).content
</js>
